owner_decisions: AM-0023 addresses eight OpenCode stuck-task failure modes (OC-STUCK-01 through OC-STUCK-08).
These are required host-kit acceptance criteria, not optional notes or prompt-only guidance.
The harness must own recovery outside the model turn.
Child permissions must inherit primary agent rules with no unresolved ask or interactive question for autonomous roles.
Depth and child/session budgets are enforced in the harness independently of host config.
Coordinator-only dispatch with depth 1 and total child/session budget is required.
Out-of-band watchdog reconciles actual child terminal state, event cursor and semantic cursor.
Parent/child identity, task, worktree, lease and process group are journaled before dispatch.
Event binding to run, project directory, parent and child identifiers with scope validation.
Provider/request deadline, tool deadline, semantic soft stall and hard stall must be separate.
Adapter-owned MCP policy sets capability-specific startup/catalog/execution/no-progress deadlines.
Windows adapter resolves executable/shim policy during preflight, applies startup deadlines.
Process group/job ownership, PID/port ancestry journal, exact descendant cleanup on completion.
activation_rule: AM-0023 addresses eight OpenCode stuck-task failure modes (OC-STUCK-01 through OC-STUCK-08). The amendment is additive after AM-0022 and does not supersede any prior amendments. Activation proceeds through the canonical bounded-repair generator.
